msContents.summary: This manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya was microfilmed as part of the NGMPP project. The catalogue describes it as complete.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.colophon: || śubham || rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāmaḥ || ꣸ ꣸ ꣸ ꣸ ꣸ ꣸ ꣸

lg.l: kathayantaṃ hitārthānāṃ prabhāvānadbhutāṃs tadā |

loma
saṃ dharmmatatvajñaṃ paryyapṛchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
|| yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman bhayārttaṃ śaraṇād gatam ||
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana ||
|| ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarvve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ ||
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam ||
idam eva purā devās tulayā samatolayan |
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate ||
atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam ||
indrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśīnarasya ca ||
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śiviṃ nṛpam ||
indraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tato pajagmatuḥ ||
athoruṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt ||

śaraṇā
rthaṃ mahīpāla nilinye bhayavihvalaḥ ||
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā ||
dharmmātmānaṃ tv āhur ekaṃ sarvarājan_ mahīkṣitām ||
satyadharmmaviruddhaṃ hi katham dharmme cikīrṣasi ||
bhavān kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinam ||
kṣamayā krūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet ||
nopakārapare pi syād upakāraparo naraḥ ||

apakārapare pi tva
m upakaraparo yathā ||
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpeṣu tvam apāpakṛt ||
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣoe pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ ||
tad eṣa vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||

taṃ rakṣan_ dharmalobhena dharmam utsṛ¦
ṣṭavān asi ||
saṃtrastarūpas trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnurayaṃ khagaḥ ||
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasyābhayārthinaḥ ||

katham asmadvidhaḥ kuryāt tyā
gaṃ sadbhir vigarhita
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajecharaṇāgataṃm ||
brahmahatyāsaṃmaṃ tasya pāpam āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api ||

śaraṇāgatahantrīṇāṃ na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvaci
t ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ ||
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhān nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||
jantavaḥ parikliśyanti mṛtyos trasyanti te pi ca ||

ya
nnimittaṃ bhavechokas trāso vā krodha eva vā ||
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāṅgam api saṃtyajet ||
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||
yad uktenānumānena paro pi parirakṣitum ||

yathā hi te jī
vitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitapriyam ||
saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmāno yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitam ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arppayiṣye kapotakam ||

yad atra manyase yuktaṃ vaktuṃ
śyenāśu tad vada ||
āhārāt sarvabhūtāni sambhavanti janeśvara ||
āhāreṇa vivarddhante tena jīvanti caiva hi ||
śakyate na vinā tena dinamātro pi jīvitum ||

śakyate nnair vināpy arthai
rājan_ varttayituṃ ciram ||
nanv āhārair vvihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ ciram ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyādya mama prāṇā viśāmpate ||
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyanti panthānam apunarbhavam ||

mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putra
dāraṃ vinaśyati ||
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotas tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi ||
dharmmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmmaṃ paraṃtapa ||
avirodhī tu yo dharmmaḥ sa dharmmaḥ sadbhir ucyate ||

tasmād virodhe dharmmasya niścitya gurulā
ghavam ||
yataḥ śriyas tato rājan_ kuru dharmmavinirṇayaṃ ||
nāto bhūyaḥ paro dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara ||
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ saṃpradīyate ||

varam ekasya satyasya dattā
dyubhayadakṣiṇā ||
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasraṃ alaṃkṛtam ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||
tasya dehād vimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kutaścana ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||

durllabhaḥ puruṣo
loke sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalam ||
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā ||

sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣo
ḍaśīm ||
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imām ||
yajec ca sarvayajñaiś tu tayor abhayado 'dhikaḥ ||
api tyajed rājyam ahaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajam ||
nanv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakam ||

yan ma
māsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani ||
bhaveyam aham arttānāṃ prāṇināṃm ārttanāśakaḥ ||
na hy ahaṃ kamaye rājyaṃ na svargā nāpunarbbhavam ||
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanam ||

yathā ca nānṛtāṃ vāca
m ahaṃ etām udāhare ||
satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvara ||
āhārārthe samārambhas tavac cāyaṃ vihaṅgama ||
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyan tair vai dadāmy aham ||

ya evaṃ vihito smākaṃ
dhātrā bhakṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ ||
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryyam asty aparair mmama ||
śyenā kapotaṃ khādanti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
mā rājan sāratāṃ jñātvā kadalīskadham āruha ||

nāham uchāstramā
rgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama ||
śāstrair eva pradiṣṭo yaṃ dharmmaḥ satyadayāparaḥ ||
sarvasatveṣu yad dānaṃm ekasatve ca yā dayā ||
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikasmin viśiṣyate ||

sarvadānān na tat kuryyuḥ sarvayajñās tu kheca
ra ||
sarvatīrthābhiṣekāś ca yat kuryyāt prāṇināṃ dayā ||
vāṅmanaḥkarmmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
dayādeśitapanthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te ||
gachatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā ||

yan na bhūtahitā
rthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitam ||
jaṅgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca khecara ||
ātmavad yobhi rakṣanti te yānti paramāṃ gatim ||
prāṇinaṃ vaddhyamānaṃ hi yaḥ śaktuḥ sannupekṣate ||

sa yāti naraṅkaṃ ghoram iti prā
hu manīṣiṇaḥ ||
rājyaṃ śivir ahaṃ sumaha prayachāmi tava dvija ||
yad vā kāmayase hṛdyaṃ varjayitvā kapotakam ||
yadi rājan_ kapote te sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī ||

tataḥ kapotatulyāni sva
māṃsāni prayaccha me ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase ||
eṣa te haṃ prayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ tulayā dhṛtam ||
yad apriyaṃ tat sujano cirād duḥkhena bhāṣate ||

mamaiva priyam evaitat kasmā te bhihitāṃ cirā
t ||
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā ||
dhruvaṃ yo nārjjayed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ ||
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate ||
tataḥ kim upakārasya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā ||

nāti
riktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara ||
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayacha tulayā dhṛtam ||
|| tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ senābhiyācase ||
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt_ tad vā vada vihaṃgama ||
|| evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ ||
prahṛṣṭas tulayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ ||
tyaktātmasukhabhogechāṃ sarvasatvahitaiṣiṇaḥ ||
bhavanti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ ||

dhriyamā
ṇas tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate ||
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ ||
na vidyate tadā māṃsaṅ kapotena samaṃ kvacit ||
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ svayam ||

paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sa
rvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
nāpekṣante mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahānty api ||
atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe ||
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ca ||

tatas tasya tadā vṛddhiṃ jñātvā dharmmasthitāṃ śu
bhām ||
śākrasvarūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata ||
|| indro ham asmi bhadran te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ ||
jijñāsamānau tvām rājan_ imaṃ yajñam upāgatau ||

na tat pūrvaṃ nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyanti cā
pare ||
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ durllabhaṃ tvayā ||
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prītir abhavat tava ||
prāṇaśasaṃśayalubdheṣu na sā prāṇiṣu dehinām ||
parārthaikāntakalyāṇī svayam ekānte niṣṭhurā ||

tvayy eva kevalā
rājan karuṇā taruṇāyate ||
svakarmmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||
tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa ||
tathā sarvvātmanā vāpi tvayā doṣāḥ parājitāḥ ||

yathaiva cātmā saṃtrāṇe vāsanāpi na vidya
te ||
anātha vikale bhīte nirddhane rthini rogiṇi ||
adṛṣṭe dṛṣṭapūrve ca vāle ca karuṇā tava ||
akṛtvarṣyā viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca ||
akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ ||

paropakārajanmānāṃ
dhātrā yo vihitās tu te ||
sajalā jaladās tv eva saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ ||
ātmapraṇaiḥ paraḥ prāṇān yo naraḥ parirakṣati ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmān nāvarttayet punaḥ ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣataḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ ||
svamāṃsāny api dattāni vastuṣv anyeṣu kā kathā ||
paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ ||
na punar jjīvati ślāghyaṃ yaḥ parārthāya jīvati ||
kim atraṃ yat santaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||

na dehaśitāya jāyante canda
nadrumāḥ ||
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||
saṃpadaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat param ||
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ ||
jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi ||

yat sva
māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samutkṛttāni pārthiva ||
eṣā te bhāsvarākīrttir lloke nanu gamiṣyati ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ciraṃ mahīm ||
sarvalokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati ||

||
evam uktvā tam indrāgniī jagmatus tridaśālayam ||
rājā tu kratum iṣṭānta mumude devavac ciram ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamam ||
sa vidhūyeha pāpmānaṃ prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ ||

viciṃtya rājā svaśa
rīram adhruvaṃ yaśaś ca vai sarvajanasya durllabham ||
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau ||
